title: Conglomery Reimagined
description: a movment optimisation and exploration based modpack with movment similar to Actions & Stuff but on java
body:
A modpack making minecraft have a bunch of extra challenges structures and combat while having a ton of shaders and beautiful movment mods and resource packs making it feel new while still keeping that "minecrafty" feel all preloaded into on pack.
> Note: to make movement visuals work properly go to: Mods> search or find "not enough animations" click on the icon and follow these settings and do not tweak anything else:

Animation Smoothing = OFF

Disable Leg Smoothing = ON

Ladder Animation = OFF

Holding Up Items = No Items

> Recommended amount of ram allocated:4gb-5gb
only use on mid or higher end systems
